instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: You can still eat an apple if it has a ((bruise)).
atoms.finishSound: You can still eat an apple if it has a bruise.

atoms.b: Wasps can ((harass)) you when they are angry.
atoms.finishSound: Wasps can harass you when they are angry.

atoms.b: The tongue is a very strong ((muscle)).
atoms.finishSound: The tongue is a very strong ((muscle)).

atoms.b: The bed seems to ((occupy)) most of the room.
atoms.finishSound: The bed seems to occupy most of the room.

atoms.b: It is important to pay attention to the ((rhythm)) when you play music.
atoms.finishSound: It is important to pay attention to the rhythm when you play music.

atoms.b: He gave her a key to his house as a ((symbol)) of his love.
atoms.finishSound: He gave her a key to his house as a symbol of his love.
